questions.question: What was the first James Bond film released in cinemas?
questions.note: 1962. Casino Royale became an official Eon Bond film much later, in 2006.

questions.question: In the Harry Potter films, what school does Harry attend?
questions.note: Full name: Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.

questions.question: What is the name of Elsa and Anna’s kingdom in Frozen?
questions.note: Corona is Tangled; Atlantica is The Little Mermaid; DunBroch is Brave.

questions.question: Which superhero team’s first standalone Marvel Cinematic Universe film was released in 2012?
questions.note: Directed by Joss Whedon; it assembled Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, and Hulk.

questions.question: In The Lord of the Rings, who is tasked with destroying the One Ring?
questions.note: Bilbo found it; Frodo takes it to Mount Doom, with Sam.

questions.question: What 1993 dinosaur film, directed by Steven Spielberg, launched a major franchise?
questions.note: Based on Michael Crichton’s novel; The Lost World was the 1997 sequel.

questions.question: What is the name of Tom Cruise’s spy in the Mission: Impossible films?
What is the subtitle of the second Hunger Games film?
questions.note: Mockingjay was split into two films after that.

questions.question: In the Marvel films, what is the name of Thor’s hammer?
questions.note: Stormbreaker is the later axe; Gungnir is Odin’s spear.

questions.question: Which Star Wars film was the first one released in theaters?
questions.note: 1977, originally just titled Star Wars; later numbered Episode IV.
